verdict.rationale: Kong documents an official CLI, kongctl, that supports declarative configuration-as-code and imperative commands. It also offers a Konnect REST API for managing AI Gateways, a quickstart script, and Docker-based data planes, all of which suit headless, scripted automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions or GitOps examples), non-interactive or token-based CI authentication guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration.
